properties.claim: For every int16_t input a, the result is strictly closer to zero than every distinct int16_t value congruent to a modulo 3329.
Critical endpoint, modulus and centered-boundary examples execute the real production body and return the expected values.

mutations.change: change the independent oracle centering threshold from 1664 to 1663

authoritative_source_policy: The frozen production source is unchanged. Implementation mutants are isolated copies under the evidence directory.
input_policy: P5 has no assumptions on a or y. Both range over all int16_t values.
portability_assumption: Signed right shift follows the semantics represented by CBMC 6.9.0 on the recorded x86_64 model.
